```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyr)
library(openxlsx)

data <- read.csv(
  "C:/Users/AVITA/Downloads/花蓮縣公車.csv",
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

data$`資料代表日期(yyyy-MM-dd)` <- as.Date(
  data$`資料代表日期(yyyy-MM-dd)`,
  format = "%Y-%m-%d"
)

data <- data %>%
  filter(
    `資料代表日期(yyyy-MM-dd)` >= as.Date("2024-06-01"),
    `資料代表日期(yyyy-MM-dd)` <= as.Date("2026-06-30"),
    `票種次類型` %in% c(
      "#HUA-199",
      "#HUA-399"
    ),
    !is.na(卡號),
    trimws(as.character(卡號)) != ""
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Year = year(
      `資料代表日期(yyyy-MM-dd)`
    ),

    Month = month(
      `資料代表日期(yyyy-MM-dd)`
    ),

    月份 = sprintf(
      "%03d%02d",
      Year - 1911,
      Month
    )
  )

person_monthly <- data %>%
  count(
    Year,
    Month,
    月份,
    卡號,
    name = "月搭乘次數"
  )

person_monthly <- person_monthly %>%
  mutate(
    搭乘次數區間 = case_when(

      月搭乘次數 == 1 ~
        "僅一次",

      月搭乘次數 >= 2 &
        月搭乘次數 <= 4 ~
        "二至四次",

      月搭乘次數 >= 5 ~
        "五次以上"
    )
  )

monthly_group <- person_monthly %>%
  count(
    Year,
    Month,
    月份,
    搭乘次數區間,
    name = "人數"
  )

month_table <- tibble(
  日期 = seq(
    as.Date("2024-06-01"),
    as.Date("2026-06-01"),
    by = "month"
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    Year = year(日期),
    Month = month(日期),

    月份 = sprintf(
      "%03d%02d",
      Year - 1911,
      Month
    )
  )

full_group <- month_table %>%
  select(
    Year,
    Month,
    月份
  ) %>%
  crossing(
    搭乘次數區間 = c(
      "僅一次",
      "二至四次",
      "五次以上"
    )
  )


plot_data <- full_group %>%
  left_join(
    monthly_group,
    by = c(
      "Year",
      "Month",
      "月份",
      "搭乘次數區間"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    人數 = replace_na(
      人數,
      0
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    月份,
    搭乘次數區間,
    人數
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = 搭乘次數區間,
    values_from = 人數,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    match(
      月份,
      month_table$月份
    )
  )

table_result <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(

    總人數 =
      僅一次 +
      二至四次 +
      五次以上,

    僅一次百分比 =
      ifelse(
        總人數 == 0,
        "0.0%",
        sprintf(
          "%.1f%%",
          僅一次 / 總人數 * 100
        )
      ),

    二至四次百分比 =
      ifelse(
        總人數 == 0,
        "0.0%",
        sprintf(
          "%.1f%%",
          二至四次 / 總人數 * 100
        )
      ),

    五次以上百分比 =
      ifelse(
        總人數 == 0,
        "0.0%",
        sprintf(
          "%.1f%%",
          五次以上 / 總人數 * 100
        )
      )
  ) %>%
  select(
    月份,
    僅一次,
    僅一次百分比,
    二至四次,
    二至四次百分比,
    五次以上,
    五次以上百分比
  )

print(
  table_result,
  n = Inf
)

write.xlsx(
  table_result,

  "C:/Users/AVITA/Downloads/113年6月至115年6月花蓮縣市區客運TPASS乘客各搭乘次數區間月人數統計表.xlsx",

  rowNames = FALSE
)


month_label <- plot_data$月份

once <- plot_data$僅一次
two_four <- plot_data$二至四次
five_more <- plot_data$五次以上

all_y <- c(
  once,
  two_four,
  five_more
)


y_max <- max(
  all_y,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

y_breaks <- seq(
  from = 0,
  to = ceiling(y_max / 500) * 500,
  by = 500
)


once_y <- sqrt(once)
two_four_y <- sqrt(two_four)
five_more_y <- sqrt(five_more)


y_breaks_pos <- sqrt(y_breaks)

bottom_half <-
  (y_breaks_pos[2] - y_breaks_pos[1]) / 2

top_half <-
  (
    y_breaks_pos[length(y_breaks_pos)] -
    y_breaks_pos[length(y_breaks_pos) - 1]
  ) / 2

y_plot_min <-
  min(y_breaks_pos) - bottom_half

y_plot_max <-
  max(y_breaks_pos) + top_half

png(
  filename =
    "C:/Users/AVITA/Downloads/113年6月至115年6月花蓮縣市區客運TPASS乘客各搭乘次數區間月人數變化折線圖.png",

  width = 12,
  height = 6,
  units = "in",
  res = 300
)


windowsFonts(
  kai =
    windowsFont(
      "Microsoft JhengHei"
    )
)

par(
  family = "kai",

  mar = c(
    6,
    8,
    5,
    10
  )
)

plot(
  x = 1:length(
    month_label
  ),

  y = once_y,

  type = "n",

  xaxt = "n",
  yaxt = "n",

  bty = "n",

  xlab = "",
  ylab = "",

  xlim = c(
    0.5,
    length(month_label) + 0.5
  ),

  ylim = c(
    y_plot_min,
    y_plot_max
  ),

  xaxs = "i",
  yaxs = "i"
)

abline(
  v = 1:length(
    month_label
  ),

  col = "gray85",
  lty = 1,
  lwd = 1
)

abline(
  h =
    y_breaks_pos[
      y_breaks != 0
    ],

  col = "gray85",
  lty = 1,
  lwd = 1
)


lines(
  1:length(
    month_label
  ),

  once_y,

  type = "o",
  pch = 16,
  lwd = 2,
  col = "black"
)


lines(
  1:length(
    month_label
  ),

  two_four_y,

  type = "o",
  pch = 16,
  lwd = 2,
  col = "gray40"
)


lines(
  1:length(
    month_label
  ),

  five_more_y,

  type = "o",
  pch = 16,
  lwd = 2,
  col = "gray70"
)

mtext(
  "113年6月至115年6月花蓮縣市區客運TPASS乘客各搭乘次數區間月人數變化折線圖",

  side = 3,

  line = 1,

  at = 0.5,

  adj = 0,

  cex = 1.2,

  font = 2
)


mtext(
  "月份",

  side = 1,

  line = 2.8,

  cex = 1.3
)


mtext(
  "人數",

  side = 2,

  line = 5,

  cex = 1.3
)

x_index <- seq(
  1,
  length(month_label),
  by = 2
)

axis(
  side = 1,

  at = x_index,

  labels =
    month_label[
      x_index
    ],

  las = 1,

  lwd = 0,

  lwd.ticks = 0,

  cex.axis = 1
)


axis(
  side = 2,

  at =
    y_breaks_pos[
      y_breaks != 0
    ],

  labels =
    format(
      y_breaks[
        y_breaks != 0
      ],

      big.mark = ",",

      scientific = FALSE
    ),

  las = 1,

  lwd = 0,

  lwd.ticks = 0,

  cex.axis = 1.1
)


legend(
  x = length(month_label) * 1.02,

  y = max(
    c(
      once_y,
      two_four_y,
      five_more_y
    ),
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),

  title = "搭乘次數",

  legend = c(
    "僅一次",
    "二至四次",
    "五次以上"
  ),

  col = c(
    "black",
    "gray40",
    "gray70"
  ),

  lwd = 2,
  pch = 16,

  bty = "n",
  xpd = NA
)

dev.off()
```
